## Current Roles & Leadership
- **Lead Developer & IT Secretary** at **Nabodigonto Social Welfare Organization** (Dec 2024 – Present):
  - Promoted to the executive board as IT Secretary after designing and deploying the organization's flagship digital platform.
  - Architected dual-admin starting balance reconciliation and cash/bank audit workflows.
  - Designed dynamic 3D-flip digital member ID cards with public QR verification and automated PVC print layouts.
  - Streamlined monthly reporting with automated dues tracking and verifiable PDF audit exports.

- **Competitive Programming:** 150+ problems solved across Codeforces and LeetCode; regular participant in National Collegiate Programming Contests (NCPC).

## Key Projects
1. **Nabodigonto Platform** (Web): https://nabodigonto.conversora-tech.workers.dev
   - Edge-native community & operations platform deployed on Cloudflare Workers across a fault-isolated Turborepo monorepo.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/nabodigonto
2. **InsideJibon** (Web): https://insidejibon.shourov.workers.dev
   - High-performance bilingual (English/Bengali) EdTech platform on Cloudflare Workers edge featuring Durable Objects live classrooms, Workers AI & Vectorize RAG tutoring over video captions, and gamification streaks.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/InsideJibon
3. **Remocomp** (Open Source / Developer Tooling): https://remocomp.shourov.workers.dev
   - Open-source curated registry of frame-accurate Remotion video components, installed shadcn-style by copying source into the user's repository. Ships a three-tier token-budgeted discovery API (~160-200 tokens for a five-result search), a stdio MCP server, an npm CLI (`remocomp`, `remocomp-mcp`), and a 14-rule AST quality gate that runs identically in the browser, on Cloudflare Workers and in CI.
   - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/remocomp
4. **ARVAANA Fragrances** (Web E-Commerce): https://arvaanabd.vercel.app
   - Luxury fragrance e-commerce platform for artisanal alcohol-free attars and inspired perfumes in Bangladesh with zero-FOUC dual themes, multi-tier variant pricing, and WhatsApp concierge checkout.
5. **Quiz Management & Examination System** (Desktop / Systems):
   - Desktop examination suite developed for IIT DU Design Patterns Lab (Mini-SPL) implementing Gang of Four (GoF) patterns (Strategy, State, Factory, Observer) and SQLite persistence.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/Quiz-Management-and-Examination-System
6. **Quran Reading Tracker** (Mobile Android):
   - Offline-first habit tracking application with zero cloud telemetry and local AsyncStorage persistence.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/QuranReadingTracker
7. **Mosque Library Management System** (Web): https://mosquelibrary.vercel.app
   - Full-stack library system with Islamic book catalog, loan renewals, and committee roles.
8. **romankh3/image-comparison** (Open Source Contribution):
   - Contributed internal engine refactor (PR #255) to Maven Central visual regression testing library: state encapsulation, iterative ArrayDeque traversal, and primitive coordinate checks.
9. **TetriC** (Systems / Networking):
   - Multiplayer console Tetris game built in C11 using Windows Winsock2 (ws2_32) TCP socket programming and non-blocking I/O.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/TetriC
10. **Codeforces Solutions** (Competitive Programming):
    - Archive of 150+ competitive programming solutions covering graphs, number theory, greedy, and dynamic programming.
    - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/Codeforces
11. **LeetCode Solutions** (Algorithms / Data Structures):
    - Clean implementations for technical interview problems focusing on space/time trade-offs and reusable algorithmic patterns.
    - GitHub: https://github.com/Shourov735/LeetCode
